QUOTE: If both macros are defined, `platform.c:20-22` compiles out the whole runtime mechanism, so `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is not declared or available.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that on the macro path the setter is not declared and the runtime mechanism is compiled out. It also says `platform.h:145-160` declares the function only when the macros are undefined.
